name: Mara Velez
description: Mara gave you your first introduction. She wants the Old Quarter to have a future.

name: Rafe Bell
description: Rafe mediates disputes at the docks. His word holds only while yours does.

name: Ivo Saint
description: Ivo knows every guest and every rumor on the Strip. He remembers generosity.

name: Lin Calder
description: Lin listens to workers before bosses. Reputation means little without responsibility.

name: Selene Ash
description: Selene offers a view from Crown Heights. Her invitations always come with expectations.

name: Detective Vale
description: Vale notices when the streets get quieter. Cooperation and public goodwill can cool an investigation.
